description: Bird Safe Saskatoon highlighted City Hall's bird collision problem.
Public art could provide bird-safe window solutions.
Over 500 residents support bird-safe City Hall windows.

chips.text: Is the city allowed to use City Hall windows as a public art space?
Over 500 residents signed a petition supporting bird deterrents at City Hall.
City Hall's north facade is one of Saskatoon's worst sites for bird collisions.
